description: The Infra Progress Layout Visual is an advanced Power BI custom visual developed to help project managers, planners, engineers, and developers monitor and analyze construction progress across large-scale infrastructure and housing projects. Unlike traditional maps, the visual uses a fully customizable coordinate-based layout system, enabling accurate rendering of site plans, villa layouts, utility corridors, and infrastructure networks directly inside Power BI. The visual supports simultaneous visualization of plots, roads, and utility systems such as water, sewage, storm drainage, electrical, telecom, and irrigation networks within a single interactive interface.
